name: Protests
overview: Scripture calls for righteous judgment and careful discernment when addressing grievances among people, emphasizing fairness toward both neighbors and strangers alike. Believers are urged to listen attentively to the cries of the poor and needy, advocating on their behalf with justice and integrity. The warnings against ignoring injustice highlight the consequences of sowing iniquity and the danger of growing cold in love as wickedness increases. Thus, protests and appeals should be grounded in truth, prudence, and a heart committed to defending righteousness.
